name: Victor Alvarez
message: Good morning. We run three gyms and are growing fast, which is exactly the problem. New members sign up through our website and also through Instagram messages, and the front desk copies everything into a spreadsheet by hand. Trainer schedules are shared in WhatsApp groups, people swap shifts without telling anyone, and last month two classes had no trainer. Invoices for personal training are written in Word. I know this is a lot, and I am not technical, but I would like to know what you would fix first and roughly how long it would take.
